name: Benecar - Cidade do Automóvel
note: Car dealer founded 10 April 1991 in Benedita (Alcobaça), presenting itself as 'Grupo Benecar' (Cidade do Automóvel); its own site describes the business but names no shareholder. Recorded during the Casa Pia research (issue #390); Benecar is the back-of-shirt sponsor of Casa Pia's 2026-27 home kit.
